summary: Treat gray cells as impassable walls, red as the unique start, green as the unique goal, and zeros as traversable. Compute cardinal distances from both markers. Recolor a zero cyan exactly when its red distance plus green distance equals the optimal red-to-green distance, marking the union of every tied shortest path while preserving walls, markers, and longer-detour zeros.
